lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule for Uganda in 2022. Geographic boundaries were classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity levels, with metadata including collection dates, scenarios, and assistance eligibility flags. Data was compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for near-term projections.
